document.about: Statistics Canada Privacy Act annual report 2024-2025, 54 pages. Its statistical report pages keep a fillable form's prompts, set in the colour of their fields.

notes: 2026-11-27: a form prompt set in its field's own colour read as text among the report's figures.

checks.issue: A form's prompt, set in its field's colour, read among the figures: `You must enter an institution's name`.
